expression: Expression is what each of you brings to the world and how you tend to work. Read the pair below as two working styles meeting, not as two characters. The numbers come from names, so they say more about habits of effort than about who anyone is.
soulUrge: Soul urge is what each of you wants underneath, the motive behind your choices, and it is often quieter than what you say you want. Read the pair below as two motives meeting. It is a prompt for talking about wants, not a reading of anyone's heart.
